meta_title: Rebind — remap keys, mouse buttons and trackpad gestures on macOS
meta_description: A free native app for macOS: map keys, mouse buttons and trackpad or Magic Mouse gestures to shortcuts and system actions. No subscription, no account, no analytics.
hero_title: Every key and button works for you
hero_lead: Rebind turns keys, mouse buttons and trackpad or Magic Mouse gestures into shortcuts and macOS actions. Setup takes a minute, and it works in every app.
download_pending: The release is coming to GitHub soon
stat_price_label: forever, with no subscription or paid features
stat_data_label: bytes of your data leave your Mac
stat_inputs_label: input devices, from the keyboard to Magic Mouse
app_label: The Rebind window with a list of bindings
app_keyboard_subtitle: Choose what each key or shortcut does.
app_mouse_subtitle: Choose what mouse buttons and gestures do.
scenarios_title: Bindings that save you time every day
scenarios_lead: Four ideas most people start with. Each takes less than a minute to set up.
scenario_mouse_title: Put the side buttons to work
scenario_mouse_text: Outside the browser, Back and Forward do nothing. Give them Mission Control and your desktops.
scenario_presses_text: Rebind tells a press, a double press and a hold apart. A single F13 key is enough to run your music.
scenario_windows_text: Left half, right half or the whole screen. No dragging, no aiming for corners.
scenario_launch_title: Open what you need at once
scenario_launch_text: An app, a file, a website or an Apple Shortcut on a single key, from any window.
try_lead: Click the field and press any key combination. Recording a binding in Rebind works exactly the same way.
try_placeholder: Click, then press a key combination
try_result: Done. In Rebind this binding works in every app right away.
try_privacy: This page stores nothing and sends nothing.
actions_title: There is an action for every press
actions_lead: The searchable catalog covers windows and desktops, sound and media, apps, websites and Apple Shortcuts.
why_free_text: No subscription, no trial, no paid features. The source code is open under the MIT license.
why_native_title: Made for macOS, not ported to it
why_native_text: SwiftUI and AppKit, light and dark appearance, an icon in the menu bar. It looks and behaves like a system utility.
why_private_title: What you type stays with you
why_private_text: Rebind never records what you type, asks for no account and sends no analytics. Your bindings live in a local file.
why_profiles_text: Work, editing, games: each gets its own set of bindings. Switch profiles from the menu bar.
why_pause_text: Need a plain keyboard for a while? Pause every binding from the menu bar and resume the same way.
steps_title: Your first binding in a minute
step1_text: Press a key or a mouse button. For a trackpad or Magic Mouse, pick a gesture from the list.
step2_text: Find it in the catalog, or record the keyboard shortcut you want to send.
step3_text: The binding works immediately, everywhere. Rebind stays in the menu bar, out of your way.
faq_free_a: Yes. Every feature is available without payment, subscription or sign-up, and the source code is open on GitHub under the MIT license.
faq_devices_q: Does Rebind work with Magic Mouse and Magic Trackpad?
faq_devices_a: Yes. The built-in trackpad, Magic Trackpad and Magic Mouse each come with a set of ready-made gestures: taps and swipes with one or more fingers. You pick a gesture from a list; there is nothing to record.
faq_access_q: Why does the app need Accessibility access?
faq_access_a: macOS only lets apps with this permission intercept keys and buttons. Rebind uses it to recognize a press and run your action. What you type is never recorded and never leaves your Mac.
faq_warning_q: Why does macOS show a warning on first launch?
faq_warning_a: The app is signed but not notarized by Apple, which requires a paid developer membership. You confirm the first launch once in System Settings, under Privacy & Security.
faq_mac_a: Any Mac running macOS 26 or later, with Apple silicon or an Intel processor.
cta_title: Make your Mac work your way
cta_text: Free, no sign-up, ready in a couple of minutes.
